evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Story assumes a catalog of music to fingerprint/search against, but the backlog lacks any user/admin capability to ingest/create/manage a music catalog or fingerprints.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires creation/maintenance of a user profile and preference data, but no story covers creating/updating a user profile or collecting listening history/preferences.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Needs user profiles/behavior data and a way to establish similarity; backlog has no stories for capturing user behavior/profile data needed for similarity computation.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Assumes existence of music videos and computed similarity features; backlog lacks a story to ingest/manage music videos (creation) and to compute/store similarity features for them.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Depends on enriched metadata and image tags being created/curated; aside from video upload with tags (ZO-006), there is no story to enrich metadata or tag images/music content for discovery.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Provides the creation/ingestion capability (upload + tags) that other video-processing stories can build on; no complementary prerequisite is missing for this story itself.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes admin segmentation management (ZO-019), which can supply segments needed to render thumbnails; no obvious missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires similarity relationships/features for videos/segments, but backlog lacks a story to compute/store similarity for video items/segments (only retrieval is stated).

evaluations.evidence: info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Assumes perceptual similarity computation exists; backlog does not include a complementary capability to generate perceptual similarity indexes/features for videos/segments.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Needs user profiles and a way to build 'similar profiles'; backlog lacks stories for creating/updating profiles and collecting interaction data to drive similarity-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Requires location acquisition and a feed/source of local news events; backlog has no story to capture user location or ingest/maintain news events data.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Identification implies a person knowledge base and/or training data plus a way to retrieve 'related information'; backlog lacks stories to create/curate person entities and associated info.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Requires a product catalog/knowledge base to map detections to 'related information'; backlog lacks any story to create/maintain that product information source.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Needs a logo reference set and associated broadcaster info; backlog does not include creation/maintenance of logo/broadcaster knowledge base.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Requires a brand knowledge base and mapping from detections to brand info; backlog lacks stories to create/curate brand entities and related information.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Includes its own creation step (capture/upload image) and a recommendation outcome; no explicit complementary CRUD step is evidenced as missing within the backlog for this capability.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to have geolocation/coverage metadata and a way to ingest/assign it; backlog lacks any story to geotag videos or define area coverage for videos.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search requires transcripts/ASR indexes to be generated and stored; backlog lacks a complementary story to run ASR on content and persist results for search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Validation/editing presupposes segmentations already exist; backlog lacks a story to create/auto-generate initial video segmentation for admins to review.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Depends on existence of 'news video segments' and a topic taxonomy/model; backlog lacks stories to ingest news videos as such and to define/manage topics used for extraction.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking can operate on ingested videos (ZO-006) and computed quality metrics; no explicit complementary CRUD capability is clearly missing from the backlog for this to be possible.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Assessment can be performed on uploaded audio/video content (ZO-006 implies ingestion); no explicit missing complementary step is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering can be applied to ingested content; backlog includes ingestion (ZO-006) and other prefiltering stories, so no clear complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Assumes low-level asset information exists, but this can be derived during ingestion/processing; backlog does not clearly evidence a missing required complementary CRUD step.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Operates on 'ingested contents' which are created by upload (ZO-006); no additional complementary capability is clearly absent for this validation to occur.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: User-provided tags are covered by upload with tags (ZO-006); system-recognized metadata can be produced by processing stories. No explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Relies on citizen annotations and Talk comments being created/available, but the backlog contains no volunteer-facing stories to create annotations or to post/comment on Talk.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on existence of annotations and Talk comments; backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to create annotations/comments, so the prompting capability is incomplete.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer data (profiles, behavior, history) to classify types; backlog lacks stories to capture/maintain volunteer attributes and activity logs needed for typing.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification can be applied to existing image datasets; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary CRUD step specific to this capability.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Detection can operate on existing images; no explicit complementary capability is evidenced as missing in the backlog for this detection to be possible.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Can be performed on existing image sets; backlog does not show a necessary complementary capability missing for this analysis.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification can be applied to existing images; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary CRUD step required for this feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Operates on existing images; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Detection can be performed on existing images; backlog does not indicate a missing prerequisite capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization can be applied to existing images; no complementary CRUD step is evidenced as missing.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Detection can operate on existing images; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Can be computed from existing images; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Preclassification can be applied to existing images; backlog does not show a necessary complementary CRUD step missing.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Analysis can be performed on existing videos; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary capability required for this processing.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Detection can be performed on existing videos; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Detection can operate on existing satellite images; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary CRUD step.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer experience data and recorded classifications; backlog lacks volunteer-facing stories to perform classifications and to track experience/history needed for weighting.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering can be applied to existing images; no complementary capability is evidenced as missing.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Detection can operate on existing images; backlog does not indicate a missing prerequisite capability.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio processing can be applied to existing audio files; backlog does not evidence a missing complementary CRUD step.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping can be performed on existing audio files/calls; backlog does not clearly evidence a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Identification can be performed on existing audio files; no explicit missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires a mechanism to actually interrupt/notify volunteers and data about volunteer state/activity; backlog lacks complementary stories to deliver interruptions/notifications to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Assumes an interruption delivery channel exists (messaging/notification UI) and content assets to send; backlog lacks stories to implement sending interruptions to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires an education delivery mechanism and volunteer performance/state signals; backlog lacks complementary stories to present education to volunteers and to capture signals needed to trigger it.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Assumes capability to deliver educational content to volunteers; backlog lacks stories to create/manage educational content and to deliver it in the volunteer UI.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires a repository of education 'pieces' to choose from and a delivery mechanism; backlog lacks stories to create/manage educational items and present them to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Depends on volunteers being able to make comments on subjects (Talk), but backlog contains no story enabling volunteers to post comments; only admin/bot reactions are described.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot commenting presupposes an underlying commenting capability on subjects; backlog lacks the complementary feature to post comments (and likely to host Talk threads) for bot/volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Requires a channel to deliver explanations (as comments/messages) and content to explain; backlog lacks complementary stories to deliver bot explanations to volunteers/users.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Assumes Zoonibot can communicate with volunteers; backlog lacks complementary stories implementing the messaging/comment delivery mechanism to volunteers.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Requires similarity features/metrics for 'subjects' and a way to compute/store them; backlog lacks a complementary story to generate subject similarity data.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Needs recorded volunteer experience/history across projects and a way to capture it; backlog lacks volunteer activity tracking/profile stories needed to support such recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarizing/reusing articles presupposes articles exist and are managed; backlog lacks stories to create/ingest/store articles and to retrieve them for summarization.
